content: # Comprehensive Visual & UI Layer Research Report: Spectra This report provides an in-depth breakdown of the visual and user interface layer of **Spectra** (`c:\Users\Arthur Henrique\Documents\GitHub\Spectra\web`), including view structure, CSS styles, JavaScript interactions, color palette, typography, and specific visual patterns that appear artificial, overly generic, or AI-generated. --- ## 1. Inventory of UI Views & Sections The application is structured into three main full-page stages (`.view`), managed dynamically via CSS class `.active`: ### Stage 1: Onboarding View (`#onboarding-view`) - **Brand Header & Hero**: - `SPECTRA` logo with extreme letter-spacing (`0.22em`, 26px uppercase, 800 weight) and sub-tagline `"AI Interview Coach"` (`web/index.html#L27-L30`). - Subtitle: *"Set up your profile, AI preferences, and API credentials."* - **Tab Navigation Bar (`.tabs-nav`)**: - 4 pill-style tabs: `1. Your Profile`, `2. AI Setup`, `3. Advanced Config`, `4. Commands & Tips`. - **Tab 1: Your Profile (`#profile-tab`)**: - **Quick Presets Grid** (`.interview-presets-section`, `web/index.html#L45-L75`): 3 cards ("Live Coding & DSA", "System Design", "Behavioral & HR") featuring emoji icons (`⚡`, `🏗️`, `💬`) and pill badges ("Ultra-Fast", "Architecture", "STAR Method"). - **Candidate Profile Fieldset**: Inputs for `Name`, `Company`, `Target Role`, `Resume Textarea`, and a `"📄 Upload PDF"` file upload button + status text. Includes an inline `"⚡ Demo"` button in the fieldset legend (`web/index.html#L79-L80`). - **Interview Focus Fieldset**: Checkbox grid (`Behavioral`, `System Design`, `DSA`, `Coding`, `Cultural Fit`, `HR / Screening`) and a highlighted standalone card checkbox for `💬 Brief & Human` ("Senior-level answers in one natural paragraph"). - **Job Description / Requirements Fieldset**: Multiline textarea for pasting job context. - **Tab 2: AI Setup (`#ai-setup-tab`)**: - **AI Configuration**: Two-column layout for Primary AI Model and Secondary AI Model (Provider and Model `
